definition: Climate-informed advice on farm, livestock or fisheries decisions. Includes planting, irrigation and stock protection; excludes information without actionable advice.
Climate-informed decisions on water allocation, irrigation scheduling or drought response by authorities or utilities. Farm-level advice may also qualify when explicit.
Climate-informed selection or prioritisation of adaptation investments, maintenance or asset-management actions. Excludes information display without decision support.
Uses climate or hazard information with household or registry data to identify recipients of shock-related support. Generic social registries alone are insufficient.

type_name: Advisory to households, firms and communities
definition: Climate-informed advice to households, firms or communities outside farm and water-management applications. Excludes hazard alerts without a distinct advisory function.
